business: Retain or reconstruct only the exact required bytes of the candidate package after privacy, closure and binding checks. Atomic publication must not overwrite a destination or invent an outcome after an uncertain write.
bridge: AlchLang selects byte limits, privacy probes, source/destination members and acceptance/refusal policies. Generic adapters hold immutable byte references, report literal byte/JSON observations and perform atomic no-replace publication.
system: A local JSON pipe keeps bounded content-addressed byte and value stores. Original-file SHA and selected canonical-value SHA remain distinct. Read anchors every path component; publication delegates to the existing generic renameat2/fsync primitive. No Define behavior is implemented in the byte store or probe.
privacy_observation: Marker byte matches, exact normalized key-name matches, strict UTF-8 status and strict JSON status only; excluded markers/keys are selected by authored AlchLang.
outcome_unknown: A dispatched publication without definitive completion requires inspection, never automatic redispatch.
